DuplicateSplitEntry(address,bytes32).notice: Reverts when two canonical entries use the same account and label.

InvalidAssetPolicyRegistry(address).notice: Reverts when the factory is initialized with an invalid asset policy registry.

InvalidEntryCount(uint256).notice: Reverts when a split profile has zero entries or exceeds the entry limit.

InvalidSplitAccount(uint256).notice: Reverts when a split entry account is the zero address.

InvalidSplitShare(uint256).notice: Reverts when a split entry share is zero or above the denominator.

InvalidSplitTotal(uint256).notice: Reverts when split entry shares do not sum to the denominator.

SplitWalletAddressPoisoned(bytes32,addre.notice: Reverts when the deterministic wallet address already has unexpected code.

UnknownProfile(bytes32).notice: Reverts when a caller asks to deploy a profile that does not exist.

AssetPolicyRegistryPinned(address).notice: Emitted once when the factory pins its deployment-wide asset policy registry.

SplitProfileCreated(bytes32,bytes32,byte.notice: Emitted once when a canonical split profile is first created.

SplitProfileEntry(bytes32,uint16,address.notice: Emitted for each canonical label-level split entry in a created profile.

SplitWalletDeployed(bytes32,address,uint.notice: Emitted when the factory deploys a split wallet for a profile.

SplitWalletDiscovered(bytes32,address,ui.notice: Emitted when the factory records a pre-existing wallet with expected code.

MAX_ENTRIES().notice: Maximum canonical split entries accepted by one profile.

MAX_UNIQUE_ACCOUNTS().notice: Maximum unique recipient accounts accepted by one profile.

PROFILE_DOMAIN().notice: Domain separator label for v1 split profile identifiers.

SCHEMA_VERSION().notice: Split profile schema version used in profile identifiers and events.

WALLET_VERSION().notice: Split wallet implementation version used in profile identifiers and events.

assetPolicyRegistry().notice: Deployment-wide registry for approved standard ERC-20 split assets.

createProfile((address,uint32,bytes32)[].notice: Creates or reuses a canonical split profile and deploys its deterministic wallet.

deployWallet(bytes32).notice: Deploys the deterministic wallet for an existing profile if it is not deployed.

profileEntriesHash(bytes32).notice: Returns the canonical entry hash committed by a split profile.

profileEntry(bytes32,uint256).notice: Returns one canonical profile entry by sorted index.

profileEntryCount(bytes32).notice: Returns the number of canonical entries stored for a profile.

profileExists(bytes32).notice: Returns whether a split profile has been created by this factory.

profileIdFor((address,uint32,bytes32)[],.notice: Computes the profile identifier for entries after canonical sorting.

profileMetadataURIHash(bytes32).notice: Returns the immutable metadata URI hash committed by a split profile.

profileUniqueAccount(bytes32,uint256).notice: Returns one unique account and its aggregate share by sorted account index.

profileUniqueAccountCount(bytes32).notice: Returns the number of unique accounts after label-level shares are aggregated.

splitWalletExists(bytes32).notice: Returns true when the profile wallet is deployed with expected code and metadata.

splitWalletInitCodeHash().notice: Returns the creation-code hash used for deterministic wallet addresses.

splitWalletRuntimeCodeHash().notice: Returns the runtime-code hash accepted for deployed split wallets.

walletFor(bytes32).notice: Returns the CREATE2 wallet address for a profile whether or not it is deployed.

userdoc.notice: Creates immutable split profiles and their deterministic native split wallets.
